job: fbl1: first long episode on the Facebook Page, native video
approval: Only run this after Mostafa's own yes in the Buffer thread to uploading the Egypt-Sudan long episode through Buffer (Claude asked him at 10:5x UTC Oct 20). Without it, do nothing.
steps: 1. Via the Buffer API (and the Page if readable), check that no Egypt-Sudan long video is already posted or scheduled on the FB Page. If it is, stop and report.

2. Find the Egypt-Sudan master under D:\1deishoo channel (see FILES\social\fb-long-episodes-check.md). READ/COPY ONLY: copy it to D:\rtmp; never move, rename or edit anything in D:\1deishoo channel. It must match the YouTube version https://youtu.be/T84u1ievIsw (17:47). If the local file is a different length, stop and report before uploading.

3. Upload the D:\rtmp copy as a release asset (see 'method'). Schedule it on Buffer's Facebook Page channel as a normal video post for Wed 2026-10-21 21:00 Cairo (UTC+3), with the title and description below. If Buffer has no title field, put the title as the first line of the text.
4. Never type passwords. No Chrome for this job.
5. Read the post back from Buffer. Then delete only the D:\rtmp copy, and keep the release asset until the post is live. Report the scheduled time, the Buffer post id and the release asset URL.
title: هل بدأت الحرب بين مصر والسودان؟ الحقيقة كاملة
description:
غارة على منجم دهب في جبل العقيدات على الحدود، وأرقام ضحايا مختلفة، ومقالات وفيديوهات بتقول إن الحرب بدأت. في الحلقة دي بنفصل الحقيقة عن الشائعات خطوة بخطوة.
في رأيك: الحرب بين مصر والسودان ممكن تحصل فعلا؟ اكتب رأيك.
#مصر #السودان #ديشو
method: BUFFER API, not Chrome (his ask 10:50 UTC Oct 20: «ما ترفع علي اي بي اي بتاعتنا»). Use Buffer's Facebook Page channel as a normal video post (not a reel), media = a public URL. GitHub raw caps files at 100 MB, so upload the D:\rtmp copy as a release asset on afaqaiteam-wq/deishoo-media (tag fb-long-egypt-sudan); release assets can be up to 2 GB. Use the asset's browser_download_url. If Buffer rejects it (size, length, post type or redirect), do NOT fall back to Chrome. Log the exact error and report. Counts toward the FB 10-post cap. Never delete posts.
